summary: All 53 requirements are implemented. The requirements give no numeric constants, so values were chosen. Several behaviours the requirements leave open were resolved as listed below.

issues.title: Plant constants have no values in the requirements
issues.raw: SB-DM1..SB-DM3 name C, M1, M2, N1, N2, W, U1, U2 and P but give no values.
issues.fix_directive: Chosen C=1000, M1=100, M2=900, N1=400, N2=600 (litre); W=25 (l/s); U1=U2=2 (l/s/s); P=10 (l/s); 4 pumps; cycle 5 s; STOP threshold 3. All whole numbers, so the constants interface's rounding does not change them. Replace them with the real plant values when known.

issues.title: One cycle = one TransmissionComplete event
issues.raw: SB-V3: all messages of a cycle are received simultaneously; step takes a single event.
issues.fix_directive: BoilerSensor.receive collects the cycle's messages; step is then called once with InputEvent.TransmissionComplete. Every transition is triggered by that event, so no transition is guard-only.

issues.title: Variables and failure detection live in the sensor stage
issues.raw: SB-V5..SB-V10 and SB-FR1..SB-FR5 need per-unit, per-cycle history that a two-level if-else with simple predicates cannot express.
issues.fix_directive: BoilerSensor maintains q, v, p, the level bounds, the unit status and the STOP count, and judges failures. The controller reads them through sensor functions, so its own state is the mode plus two initialization flags.

issues.title: Failure announcements and repair acknowledgements
issues.raw: SB-FR6/SB-FR7 require per-unit messages repeated until acknowledged.
issues.fix_directive: Each non-terminal branch calls actuator.reportUnitStatus(), which transmits sensor.statusMessagesDue(): unacknowledged detections and the acknowledgements for repairs received in this cycle.

issues.title: Regulation policy
issues.raw: SB-Beh10/15/19 say pumps are switched on or off but not how many or when.
issues.fix_directive: All four pumps are ordered on when the level (or the estimate's midpoint) is below N1. They are all ordered off when the worst-case level at the next cycle exceeds N2. Orders are sent only when they change the commanded state. A branch that changes mode sends no pump orders. In rescue mode the widening estimate makes the pumps alternate on and off.

issues.title: Level risk under worst-case behaviour
issues.raw: SB-Beh13/18/21 and SB-V4 do not define the worst case.
issues.fix_directive: Next-cycle low = lower bound - maximal steam volume (no pump assumed to pour). Next-cycle high = upper bound - minimal steam volume + P*5 s for each pump that is on, flowing or uncertain. Steam volume uses v*dt +/- U*dt^2/2, clamped to [0, W*dt].

issues.title: Transmission failure before STEAM_BOILER_WAITING
issues.raw: SB-Beh2 says nothing happens before STEAM_BOILER_WAITING; SB-Beh9/SB-FR5 require data every cycle.
issues.fix_directive: In initialization, transmission failure, non-zero steam and level failure cause emergency stop only once STEAM_BOILER_WAITING has arrived. Operator STOP applies always.

issues.title: 'the pump-controller units fail' in rescue mode
issues.raw: SB-Beh21 does not say whether one controller failure suffices.
issues.fix_directive: Any pump controller out of order forces emergency stop from rescue mode.

issues.title: MODE after emergency stop
issues.raw: SB-Beh24 says MODE is sent every cycle; SB-Beh22 says the program stops.
issues.fix_directive: MODE(emergency stop) is sent in the cycle that enters the mode; nothing is sent afterwards.

issues.title: Initialization filling and draining
issues.raw: SB-Beh5 says 'a pump'; no evacuation rate is given for the valve.
issues.fix_directive: Pump 1 fills. The level-dynamics check is skipped during a cycle when the valve was open, because no evacuation rate is given. The valve is closed when the level is in [N1, N2] and when initialization is left.

issues.title: Pump and pump-controller judgement timing
issues.raw: SB-FR1/SB-FR2 give the transmission after which a pump or a controller is judged.
issues.fix_directive: A pump fails when its reported state differs from its commanded state. A controller is judged only while its pump is sound, from the second transmission after an order. It fails when the reported flow differs from the commanded state. After a repair, a pump's reported state becomes the commanded state.

issues.title: Aberrant messages
issues.raw: SB-FR5 does not list the aberrant messages.
issues.fix_directive: Aberrant: STEAM_BOILER_WAITING outside initialization. PHYSICAL_UNITS_READY not answering a PROGRAM_READY of the previous cycle. A repair notice for a unit that is not out of order. A failure acknowledgement with no pending announcement. A pump number outside 1..4. A data message missing or duplicated.

next_step: Run the pipeline; review the invented constants and the resolved ambiguities.
